```{r echo=TRUE}
library(Seurat)
library(anndata)
library(Matrix)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
# Read the RDS file (this should now work)
obj <- readRDS("GSM8528725_MPS.rds")
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
# ---- Check object type ----
cat("Object class:", class(obj), "\n")
# Check what assays are available
print("Assay names:")
print(assayNames(obj))
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
# Load required libraries
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# Read the object
obj <- readRDS("GSM8528725_MPS.rds")

# Print a concise summary of the object
print(obj)

# Check which assays are present (should be "counts")
print(assayNames(obj))

# Check for alternative Experiments (often used for multimodal data)
print(altExpNames(obj))

# Check reduced dimensions (e.g., PCA, UMAP)
print(reducedDimNames(obj))

# Check rowData and colData names
print(names(rowData(obj)))
print(names(colData(obj)))

# Check if there are additional metadata elements
print(names(metadata(obj)))

# List all available slots (advanced)
print(slotNames(obj))
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
# RNA counts (main assay)
rna_counts <- assay(obj, "counts")   # features x cells

# ATAC counts (alternative experiment)
atac_obj <- altExp(obj, "ATAC")
atac_counts <- assay(atac_obj, "counts")  # features x cells

# Metadata (colData) includes guide_id and guide_gene
metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(obj))

# Transpose to cells x features
rna_counts <- t(rna_counts)
atac_counts <- t(atac_counts)

# Save as RDS
saveRDS(rna_counts, "rna_counts.rds")
saveRDS(atac_counts, "atac_counts.rds")
saveRDS(metadata, "metadata.rds")
```

```{r echo=TRUE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Matrix)

# Load the RDS object
obj <- readRDS("GSM8528725_MPS.rds")

# RNA: original is genes x cells; transpose to cells x genes
rna_counts_orig <- assay(obj, "counts")
rna_counts <- t(rna_counts_orig)
gene_names <- rownames(rna_counts_orig)

# ATAC: from altExp
atac_obj <- altExp(obj, "ATAC")
atac_counts_orig <- assay(atac_obj, "counts")
atac_counts <- t(atac_counts_orig)
peak_names <- rownames(atac_counts_orig)

# Metadata (colData)
metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(obj))

# Install anndata if not already
if (!require(anndata)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
  remotes::install_github("theislab/anndata")
  library(anndata)
}

# Create AnnData object
adata <- AnnData(
  X = rna_counts,
  obs = metadata,
  var = data.frame(gene = gene_names),
  obsm = list(ATAC = atac_counts)
)
# Store peak names in uns
adata$uns[['peak_names']] <- peak_names

# Save to H5AD
adata$write_h5ad("multiperturb_seq.h5ad")

cat("Saved multiperturb_seq.h5ad\n")
```
